layer_3_action.subject: Mamenchisaurus
features: an extraordinarily long, slender neck spanning nearly 50% of its total body length, extended forward in a wide horizontal sweep
small, deep skull profile featuring a cleanly closed mouth, large expressive soulful eyes, and an innocent, gentle facial expression
massive pillar-like legs with thick, rounded feet and blunt, non-threatening claws
large, heavy-set barrel torso with a deep chest and a gently sloping back line
exceptionally long, tapering whip-like tail held elevated off the ground in a smooth counterbalancing curve
high-fidelity 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized, slightly rounded edges
leathery skin with subtle specular highlights, organic pebbled scale patches, and a vibrant pale mint-green base color accented by soft lavender-purple dappled spots along the neck and upper back
layer_3_action.action: A calm, immense Mamenchisaurus stands gracefully among lush, mossy riverbanks, its impossibly long neck sweeping across a wide arc to forage on the high-canopy leaves of ancient Ginkgo trees under bright, cinematic sunlight.
